language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hello, my name is Ela. I manage this garden center. We sell and grow many varieties of Elephant Ear plants here.
As the manager, I'm responsible for all the day-to-day operations. I keep track of how many plants are sold each day by graphing the sales.
Graphs are used to display data and information. Data that shows changes over time is best displayed by line graphs.
I have put the data from the table into a line graph. Now it is easy to see the changes in the total number of Elephant Ear plant sales from 2007 till 2011.

backgroundLayers.text:
Sale of elephant plants from
year 2007 to 2011

dialog.text: What this data now tells me is: How the total sales have increased or decreased from 2007 to 2011.
That the total number of plants sold in 2007 was 75 and in 2011 was 115.
That 115 is more than 75, so there is definite increase in sales over the years.
Line graphs make it easy to interpret given data.
Now let's learn more about line graphs!
